operations.source_excerpt: [F1] On $\mathbb R^r$, $\langle x,y\rangle=\sum_{k=1}^r x_k y_k$ and $\|x\|_2^2=\langle x,x\rangle$; in particular $\langle x,x\rangle=0$ implies $x=0$ ([[def-euclidean-inner-product]]).
operations.proposed_replacement: [F1] On $\mathbb R^r$, coordinates are indexed by $k<r$, and $\langle x,y\rangle=\sum_{k<r} x_k y_k$ and $\|x\|_2^2=\langle x,x\rangle$; in particular $\langle x,x\rangle=0$ implies $x=0$ ([[def-euclidean-inner-product]]).
